items.title: Understanding Malleability
items.explanation: Malleability is the property of materials that allows them to be beaten into thin sheets without breaking. Most metals possess this property, while non-metals like coal and sulfur are brittle and break when hammered.

items.title: Understanding Ductility
items.explanation: Ductility is the property of materials that allows them to be drawn into wires. Metals such as copper and aluminium are ductile, enabling the creation of electrical fittings, musical instrument strings, and decorative wire ornaments.
